description: Tell the business how the buyer's purchasing works for this offer: whether the seller must be an approved vendor, whether a purchase order is required, which documents are needed, the seller's vendor id with the buyer, where orders and invoices go, and the payment terms. Recorded as the buyer's statement; the business answers it in inspect_offer thread.purchasing. Nothing here orders or pays.

id.description: The request or offer id from your receipt or customer link

name.description: Name of the person making this for the buyer

organization.description: The buyer's organization, whose purchasing this is

documents_required.description: Documents the buyer's purchasing needs from the seller, such as a W-9 or an insurance certificate

route.description: How the buyer's purchasing takes orders and invoices: a portal URL, email or API

terms_sha256.description: Exact terms_sha256 from inspect_offer; the act is refused if the terms have changed since

token.description: Private token from your receipt or customer link; keep it for later visits

name: state_purchasing_requirements
title: State the buyer's purchasing requirements
